kpis.sub: Rs 182.63 (Series B CCPS placement to Abakkus Four2eight Opportunities Fund, 17-Jul-2026, Rs 1,461 per Rs 10 preference share, converting 1:1 to Rs 5 shares after the 3:1 bonus and 1:2 split)

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow was negative in all three years: -286.59 / -641.12 / -152.83 (Rs m, FY26/25/24) against PAT 653.79 / 235.52 / -40.50. Cumulative CFO is -1,080.54 m against cumulative PAT of 848.81 m. Receivables and inventory absorbed Rs 972.55 m and Rs 388.97 m in FY26 alone; capex of Rs 893.28 m was funded by debt and preference capital.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Subsidiary Ekkaa Electronics Industries was owned by promoter-directors until 29-Aug-2025 and was the issuer's largest customer in FY25 (Rs 1,043.40 m, 21.01% of revenue) and a large supplier (Rs 894.49 m purchases); the issuer borrowed Rs 1,708.58 m from it in FY25. Acquisition price Rs 490.00 m (Rs 397.58 m in shares at Rs 888 and Rs 92.42 m cash), paid to the two promoter-directors. FY26 revenue still includes Rs 758.07 m (6.20%) of sales to it before acquisition. Rent and an advance to promoter-linked entities (Gaurisuta) in FY26.

focus.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
focus.detail: The restated accounts record the Rs 490 m acquisition as a bargain purchase: customer-relationship intangible Rs 37.08 m and capital reserve Rs 20.39 m, no goodwill. The proforma balance sheet shows goodwill of Rs 84.99 m for the same transaction: the two documents carry different purchase accounting. The seller was a related party of the issuer.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Demand: LED televisions 71.78% of FY26 revenue; top customer 16.86%, top-5 52.43%, top-10 65.77% (FY25: 21.01%, 70.05%, 80.35%); customers unnamed. Supply: top supplier 46.94%, top-5 69.74%, top-10 79.11% of FY26 raw-material purchases; imported open cells and PCB parts. Geographic split not disclosed.

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: FY24 and FY25 restated figures derive from special-purpose Ind AS statements prepared for the offer (previous GAAP statutory accounts; transition date 01-Apr-2024). Statutory auditor M S K A & Associates LLP. Backup log of the accounting software kept only from 18-Feb-2026; audit-trail feature stated as enabled throughout FY26.

focus.title: SME conditions
focus.detail: Offer is made under Reg 6(2) (at least 75% to QIBs) because the issuer does not satisfy Reg 6(1)(b): operating profit was negative (Rs -11.96 m) in FY24. Average operating profit over three years Rs 487.76 m; net tangible assets Rs 2,532.49 m; monetary assets 0.92% of net tangible assets.

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: Bonus (1:1 on 28-Aug-2025, 3:1 on 20-Aug-2026) and the 1:2 split are applied to every period: FY26 EPS 9.04 on about 72.3 m weighted shares, FY25 EPS 3.63, FY24 EPS (0.62), all on the post-bonus count. Basic EPS already counts the compulsorily convertible preference shares, so basic and diluted EPS are equal.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 145.42 m on PBT Rs 796.30 m (18.3%) in FY26; cumulative current tax 15.6% of cumulative PBT (Rs 163.74 m / Rs 1,048.80 m). The statutory rate applied is 17.16% (concessional manufacturing regime). Cash taxes paid were Rs 59.60 m over three years against Rs 163.74 m current tax charged, with Rs 131.71 m of current tax liability unpaid at 31-Mar-2026.

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: No contingent liability requiring disclosure at 31-Mar-2026. Capital commitments not reviewed.
